resource.description: Submit a single string and target language code to receive an accurate machine translation in seconds. LinguaBridge Translate covers over 60 language pairs with domain-tuned models for everyday, business, and technical text, and returns plain translated text ready to drop into your product. Built for high-throughput apps that need per-call pricing rather than a subscription.

Send any snippet of text as query parameters and get back the detected language code with a confidence score, ideal for routing incoming support tickets, comments, or documents to the right translation or moderation pipeline. Handles short and ambiguous text more reliably than dictionary-based detectors by scoring across candidate languages. Offered with a metered per-call rate and an optional capped-spend billing mode for predictable batch jobs.

Upload a batch of documents for asynchronous translation and poll the returned job for status until completion. DocBridge Batch Translate is built for large document sets, such as contracts, manuals, and product catalogs, where per-string calls would be impractical, and results are checked on an hourly cadence rather than real time. Runs on Stellar pubnet for production-grade batch pricing.

Convert names, addresses, and short phrases between writing systems, for example Cyrillic to Latin or Devanagari to Latin, while preserving pronunciation rather than meaning. ScriptShift focuses on the language pairs and scripts most requested in South and Southeast Asian and Eastern European markets, returning transliterated text over a simple query-parameter GET call. Billed on a capped, upto-only schedule so callers never pay more than their configured ceiling.

Translate text while enforcing a customer-supplied terminology glossary, so brand names, product terms, and legal phrases are rendered exactly as required instead of left to the model's discretion. Returns a structured JSON object with the translated text plus a list of which glossary terms were matched and applied. Offered as a free introductory tier on both Stellar testnet and pubnet while the glossary index is in preview.

An MCP tool that returns a ranked list of current top headlines for a requested category or region, refreshed live as stories break. NewsPulse Headline Feed is designed for agent workflows that need a quick, structured news snapshot rather than a full search index, and supports both metered per-call pricing and a capped upto billing mode for always-on monitoring agents. Delivered over Stellar pubnet.

Post a list of keywords or entity names and receive back the newest matching articles published across tracked global sources, suitable for building real-time alerting pipelines. Every response is cryptographically signed so downstream systems can verify the feed content was not tampered with in transit. Priced per call on Stellar pubnet with exact-amount billing only.

Query a chronological timeline of news coverage for a named company, person, or organization, refreshed hourly and aggregated across both Stellar testnet and pubnet payment rails. Pricing is pay-as-you-go with a capped billing option, so you only ever pay up to your configured per-query spend ceiling. Returns a list of timestamped article summaries ordered newest-first.

A regional feed of corporate and institutional press releases, refreshed hourly and queried via simple GET parameters for issuer, region, or date range. WireDesk focuses on primary press-release wire content rather than reported news, making it useful for compliance and investor-relations monitoring workflows. Available on Stellar testnet at a flat per-call rate.
